item.title: Upgrading
item.description:
What each release needs from you, when it needs anything. Releases not listed here are drop-in.

2026.9.8

Converters are generated beside your repositories

converter.mapConverterClass used to default to com.example.persistence.converter.ToMapConverter, and every generated converter is written to the package that setting names. A project that set repositories.basePackageName and nothing else therefore had its repositories generated where it asked and its converters generated into the example’s package — a name it had never written down, reached through a setting it had never heard of.
